channel.title: Aroido Blog
channel.description: Product notes, release thinking, and operating decisions from Aroido.

item.title: Why We Kept the Blog in Git
item.description: Why a same-repo Markdown blog fits the current Aroido site better than adding a database or CMS too early.

item.title: What We Watch in Multi-Repo AI Teams
item.description: Three signals that usually show a team has outgrown copy-paste repo setup and needs a stronger operating layer.

item.title: Phase 1 Is Public. Phase 2 Is Not the Promise Yet.
item.description: Why we prefer shipped proof and public validation before widening the promise around future workflow features.

item.title: Release Notes Should Teach Something
item.description: A short note on why updates are more credible when they explain the decision behind the change instead of listing UI motion.

item.title: How We Decide a Page Is Ready
item.description: The bar is not visual polish alone. A page is ready when message, structure, and action path all survive the same review.

item.title: Why We Write Before We Scale
item.description: Specs, release notes, and product pages all do the same job for us: they reduce ambiguity before more people touch the work.
